# Metadata Inventory

**Author:** CJ Tinant

**Last Updated:** `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`

This document provides an up-to-date listing of metadata files stored in `docs/metadata/`, used for covariate processing and QA in the regional skew modeling workflow.

## Table of Contents

- [Metadata Inventory](#metadata-inventory)
  - [Metadata Files in docs/metadata](#metadata-files-in-docsmetadata)

## Metadata Files in docs/metadata

```{r metadata-inventory, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)


# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g. data-dictionaries/)
# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g., data-dictionaries/)
metadata_files <- dir_info(here("docs", "metadata"), recurse = TRUE) %>%
  filter(type == "file") %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = path_file(path),
    ext = path_ext(path),
    # Subdirectory within docs/metadata
    folder = path_rel(path_dir(path), start = here("docs", "metadata")),
    # Replace "." (top-level) with "metadata"
    folder = if_else(folder == ".", "metadata", folder)
  ) %>%
  # Optional: custom folder order
  mutate(
    folder = factor(
                    folder,
                    levels = c(
                      "data-dictionaries",
                      "descriptions",
                      "look-up-tables",
                      "metadata",
                      "raster-data-summaries",
                      "vector-data-summaries"
                    )),
    size_kb = round(size / 1024, 1),
    size_display = if_else(size < 1024, "<1 KB", paste0(size_kb, " KB"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(folder, file_name) %>%
  select(folder, file_name, ext, size_display) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(file_name, "^README\\."))

file_descriptions <- tribble(
  ~file_name, ~description,
  "covariate-inventory_data-dictionary_v02.csv", "Covariate inventory field descriptions",
  "nhd-flowlines_data-dictionary_v01.csv", "NHD flowlines field descriptions",
  "peakflow-gage_site-criteria_data-dictionary.csv", "Peakflow gage site field descriptions",
  "peakflow-gage_data-dictionary_v01.csv", "Peakflow gage site field descriptions",
  "statsgo2_data-dictionary_v01.csv", "STATSGO2 map unit polygon field descriptions",
  "us_ecoregions_data-dictionary_v03.csv", "US Ecoregion Level I-IV data dictionary",
  "ned_data-dictionary-full_2014.pdf", "National Elevation Dataset field definitions",
  "covariate_metadata_v082.csv",

  "koppen-geiger_class_lut.csv", "Köppen climate class lookup table",
  "us-ecoregion_field_metadata_v01.csv", "Raw US Ecoregion field metadata",
  "koppen-geiger_band_metadata_v01.csv", "Raw band number and data type metadata",

metadata_files <- left_join(metadata_files, file_descriptions, by = "file_name")

# 2. Render the table
metadata_files %>%
  select(Folder = folder,
         `File Name` = file_name,
         Extension = ext, Size = size_display,
         Description = description) %>%
  kable(align = "lcc")
```
